selection_rule: All seven available declared supplement-4 candidates, latest four reachable two-parent merges since 2018-01-01 UTC with one merge-base different from both parents, a Python change and a clean native textual merge; descending committer timestamp then SHA. Structural checks only, no oracle/detector outcome selection. Stdlib-oriented code quality, file integrity, TLS data loading, schema validation and test-control projects diversify the previous candidates. Retain every selected outcome and every earlier cohort. No dependency, M3 or scope changes.
